"''We're not in the Republic anymore, skug.|[[Echo]] and Raney|}} '''Raney''' was a [[Zygerrian]] [[Gender|male]] who was the leader of a group of Zygerrian [[enslaver]]s who operated on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]] shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Under the Empire, he hoped to return to [[Kadavo]] and rebuild the Zygerrians' [[Zygerrian Slave Empire|slave operation]] that the former [[Galactic Republic]] had [[Battle of Kadavo|ended]]. Raney's group of slavers, residing in the ruins of [[Old Ord Mantell City]], had captured several [[Slavery|enslaved]] individuals, as well as [[Muchi]], an adolescent [[rancor]] that belonged to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]]. The Hutt placed a [[bounty]] on the rescue of Muchi, and the former [[clone trooper]]s of [[Clone Force 99]] were hired to rescue Muchi by the [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]]. Though the slavers initially captured the [[trooper]]s, the young [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] freed Muchi, allowing her comrades to escape. During the ensuing skirmish, the clone [[Hunter]] briefly fought Raney, incapacitating the Zygerrian. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Raney appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]]," the fifth episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 28]], [[2021]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}} He was portrayed by [[Liam O'Brien]] and identified in the credits. Prior to the show's release, he was first pictured in a trailer for ''The Bad Batch'' on [[December 11]], [[2020]].{{SWYouTube|YB9DIxdB198|Sizzle | The Bad Batch | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-the-bad-batch}} [[File:RaneyConcept.jpg|thumb|right|310px|Concept art for Raney by Jim Moore]] Concept art was created for Raney by [[Jim Moore]], dated to [[August 6]], [[2019]] and entitled "zygerrianRaneyAvA."{{SW|url=rampage-concept-art-gallery|text="Rampage" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}} Raney's appearance in the final version of the episode differs from the concept art, which depicts the Zygerrian as having a more rounded face, with taller ears and longer fur on his cheeks and chin. The art also pictures Raney with lighter brown and gray fur and lacks his blinded eye and scar. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Raney}} *{{TBB|Rampage (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|YB9DIxdB198|Sizzle | The Bad Batch | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-the-bad-batch}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|BsOmYpP4UDU|Star Wars: The Bad Batch | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/trailer-the-bad-batch}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/rampage-episode-guide|text="Rampage" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} *{{Databank|brezak|Brezak}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|muchi|Muchi}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|old-ord-mantell-city|Old Ord Mantell City}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|raney|Raney}} *{{Databank|zygerrian|Zygerrian}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Raney |es=Raney |fr=Raney |ja=ラネー |ka=რენი (ზაიგერიანი) |nl=Raney |pl=Raney |pt=Raney }} [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Zygerrian Slave Empire members]] [[Category:Zygerrians]]
